answer: The desk only stamps a name that carries Saltbound salt retailer salt writ, and the stamp itself rests on a writ salt retailers sign after salt shop checks. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. Each name is charged 120 stamped dockets, each costing £33 to have checked, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. One mesa, one entry. Every whisper is counted once. The karst is checked, not assumed.
